hypothesis: README rendering at __main__.py discovers examples ONLY from package_path/examples/{family}/lowcode/, and build_readme_context() receives only that single-package list. No cumulative aggregation logic exists.

publish_pr_discovery.scope: Single package only — no cross-package or post-merge aggregation

build_readme_context_input.parameters: Receives examples list and single package_path
build_readme_context_input.scope: Single package only — uses package_path for fact extraction

readme_facts_extraction.scope: Single package_path — finds Program.cs in one package only

root_cause: Each publish-pr invocation renders README with only the current package's examples. When PR merges, it overwrites the README on the target branch, losing entries from prior merged PRs.
affected_scenario: Multi-package families (PDF with 7+ packages, Words with 2 packages). Single-package families (Cells, Diagram, Email, Slides) are NOT affected since all examples are in one package.

fix_design.approach: Cumulative inventory discovery via new readme_inventory.py module
source_priority: 2. PR dry-run package contents (verified locally on disk)
fix_design.package_path_map: Maps each example to its containing package for multi-package fact extraction
fix_design.staleness_gate: Fail-closed audit after README render — publish-pr fails if README misses expected examples
